This session is INBOUND FEEDBACK from another project: git-viewer (/home/bilko/Projects/git-viewer, session is-this-project-and-its-live-version-saas-we-ve--05f162ab). It was raised while working on: Is this Project and its live version SAAS?  We've had several attemps but I think the agents go lost, inspect in depth what is currently live, what is lited on Bilko's MCPs and then lets fugure out a path towards monetization.   The path must be test beforehand e.g. if you get a any public github li. Nobody in this project wrote the report below — an agent working in that project did, and it may be wrong about this codebase. Verify the claim against the code here before acting on it, and if it does not hold, say so and close the session rather than building against it.

Goal: git-viewer hosted portfolios: every NEW GitHub login returns 503 — GitHub rate budget exhausted (GITHUB_TOKEN likely unset on Render)

## Why
Git Viewer is listed on bilko.run as a freemium SaaS ("type your GitHub username… free in seconds"), and Stanislav wants to monetize it. Today the first thing a new visitor does — type their own login — fails: the page polls "generating" and then gets 503 {"status":"error"}. Only logins already in the cache (stanislavbg, octocat) render. Until new builds succeed, the product cannot acquire a single new user, free or paid.

## Proposed plan
1. Check Render env for GITHUB_TOKEN on the bilko-run service and the boot log line '[git-viewer] GitHub rate budget: … token=set|unset limit=… remaining=…' (server/routes/tools/git-viewer.ts logGitHubRateBudget).
2. If unset/invalid: set a fine-grained PAT (public-repo read only) as GITHUB_TOKEN and redeploy; confirm the boot log shows limit=5000.
3. Add a cheap health signal so this can't silently recur: e.g. expose the last boot rate-budget result + githubBudgetUntil + failed-map size on an existing admin/health route, and log a single WARN when token=unset in production.
4. Fix stale-row serving: rows with updated_at=0 (octocat shows updatedAt 1970-01-01 and 3 projects although PLAN_LIMITS.free=1) keep being served while regeneration fails; regenerate them once the budget is back, and consider re-capping a free row's projects to PLAN_LIMITS.free at serve time.
5. Verify live with three never-seen logins (e.g. torvalds, sindresorhus, gaearon): each goes 202 → 200 ready within ~60s.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] curl https://bilko.run/api/git-viewer/u/torvalds (and two other previously-uncached logins) returns 202 then 200 {status:'ready'} within 60s — no 503.
- [ ] Boot log shows '[git-viewer] GitHub rate budget: http=200 token=set limit=5000'.
- [ ] GET /api/git-viewer/u/StanislavBG returns tier 'paid' (showcase logins build paid when GITHUB_TOKEN is set, per tierFor()).
- [ ] GET /api/git-viewer/u/octocat returns an updatedAt after the fix date and at most 1 project (free tier).
- [ ] Production with GITHUB_TOKEN unset emits a visible warning/health signal rather than failing silently.

## Out of scope
- New per-repo page endpoint (/api/git-viewer/r/:owner/:repo) — will be proposed separately once git-viewer lands its repo-page builder and the pricing is decided.

## Details
Observed 2026-10-18 ~8:40 PM PDT from the git-viewer Epic:

- GET /api/git-viewer/u/torvalds → 202 generating, then 503 {"status":"error","retryAfterSec":598}. Same for sindresorhus. retryAfterSec ≈ 600 > FAILED_TTL_MS (300s), so failedTtlMs() classified the failure as a GitHub rate-limit (x-ratelimit-reset based) and githubBudgetUntil is blocking every new build.
- GET /api/git-viewer/u/StanislavBG → 200 but tier "free", 1 project, updatedAt 2026-10-18T04:26:56Z. tierFor() returns 'paid' for SHOWCASE_LOGINS only when process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN is set — so the showcase row being 'free' strongly implies GITHUB_TOKEN is unset in production (unauthenticated = 60 req/h per Render egress IP; one free build costs ~20–35 calls, so the budget is gone after 2–3 builds).
- GET /api/git-viewer/u/octocat → 200, tier free, 3 projects, lockedCount 3, updatedAt 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (updated_at=0 row; stale payload from the old 3-project free tier being served forever because regeneration fails).
- Locally, with an authenticated token, the same library (@bilkobibitkov/git-viewer buildPortfolio, maxProjects 1) builds sindresorhus, torvalds, octocat in 3–22s each — the library is fine; the host's GitHub budget is the problem.
- usage_report (14d) shows almost no metered traffic (only demo-app), so there is no telemetry to tell how many visitors hit this — worth a look too.

Responsible file: server/routes/tools/git-viewer.ts (generate(), failedTtlMs(), tierFor(), logGitHubRateBudget()); env documented in .env.example (GITHUB_TOKEN=).

Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/Bilko/server/routes/tools/git-viewer.ts
Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/git-viewer/docs/prds/10-hosted-portfolios.md

The report is correct. `GITHUB_TOKEN` is **not set** on Render, and that is the cause. Live production now reports `"gitViewer":{"githubToken":"unset",…,"ok":false}`. You have to set the token yourself in the Render dashboard; no code change can do that.

**What I confirmed live (about 9:56 PM PDT):**
- **New logins fail:** `torvalds` returned 202 "generating", then 503 with `retryAfterSec:3078`.
- **Showcase builds free:** `StanislavBG` is served as `tier:"free"`. It only builds paid when the token is set.
- **The report is wrong about octocat:** it says octocat shows 3 projects, but the stored portfolio has 1 project; the 3 is the count of locked projects. Its `updatedAt` of 1970 is deliberate: on 2026-10-14 we cut the free tier from 3 projects to 1 and reset free rows' timestamps to 0 so they rebuild at the new cap. So no re-capping when serving is needed. Those rows rebuild on their next view once the token works.

**A host bug made it worse, now fixed and pushed (`f5b1ccef`, live):**
- Viewing an out-of-date cached profile (gaearon, octocat and every other free row reset to 0) and the hourly refresh both queued rebuilds even while GitHub's limit was used up. Each one burned about 20–35 GitHub calls, failed, and pushed the time when new builds could run again further out. Both now skip rebuilding while the limit is used up.
- `/api/health` now has a `gitViewer` block. It shows whether a token is set (never its value), the last GitHub limit check (refreshed hourly), whether new builds are blocked and until when, how many builds recently failed, how many are queued, and an overall `ok` flag.
- At startup in production, the server logs a WARN if `GITHUB_TOKEN` is missing or GitHub rejects it (401).
- I added 3 tests; the full suite passes (1262 tests) and typecheck is clean.

**One oddity:** right after the deploy, `githubBudget.http` was `null`, meaning the startup call to GitHub's `/rate_limit` failed. It may just have been a slow first boot; the next hourly check will tell.

**Still open:** acceptance criteria 1–4 (new logins reach 200, startup log shows `limit=5000`, StanislavBG shows `paid`, octocat gets a fresh `updatedAt`) all depend on the token. To finish:
1. Create a fine-grained GitHub token with public-repo read only, set it as `GITHUB_TOKEN` on the bilko-run service in Render, and redeploy.
2. Run `curl https://bilko.run/api/health | jq .gitViewer`. Success looks like `githubToken:"set"`, `githubBudget.limit:5000` and `ok:true`.
3. Then try `torvalds`, `sindresorhus` and `gaearon`; each should go from 202 to 200 within about 60 seconds.

I also updated the memory note about this so future sessions check `/api/health` first.
